title: Must‑Have MSFS 2024 Aircraft This Week! Black Square Duke, C‑130J & More | PC Marketplace Update
description:
Welcome back to the weekly MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update for March 7, 2026. Today is a massive day for PC simmers as Black Square finally brings their legendary Piston and Turbine Dukes to the MSFS 2024 storefront. These aircraft represent the pinnacle of GA simulation.

We’re also checking out the Captain Sim C-130J-30 Super Hercules, a stretched military powerhouse, and the iconic Aeroplane Heaven B-25J Mitchell. If you prefer corporate flying, the Sim Federation Bombardier Challenger 350 is now live.

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 Sim Federation: Bombardier Challenger 350 (High‑performance business jet for realistic corporate operations)
🛫 Captain Sim: C‑130J‑30 Super Hercules (Iconic military transport with expanded fuselage)
🛫 Aeroplane Heaven: Mitchell‑B25J (Legendary WWII twin‑engine bomber)
🛫 Black Square: Piston Duke (Deep systems simulation with classic piston power)
🛫 Black Square: Turbine Duke (High‑performance turboprop with advanced avionics)

🎨 New Liveries added this week (PC)
The following liveries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🎨 Captain Sim: C‑130J‑30 Livery Pack 1 (Additional real‑world military paint schemes)
🎨 Captain Sim: C‑130J‑30 Livery Pack 2 (More operational and regional variants)
🎨 STOL Addicts: C‑17 USAF AFRC and ANG Livery Pack (Authentic US Air Force Reserve and ANG liveries)

If you enjoyed this Marketplace Update, don’t forget to hit the like button, subscribe for weekly MSFS content, and let me know in the comments which aircraft you’re picking up this week!

Thanks for watching and flying along
✈️ See you in the skies!
